description: Generate a monthly calendar for any month and year, with correct weekdays, leap years, today's date highlighted, and previous/next month navigation.

faqs.a: Yes. February shows 29 days in leap years such as 2028 and 2032, calculated with real calendar math — no hard-coded tables.

faqs.a: You can generate any month from January 1900 to December 2100 using the year dropdown.

howto: Pick a month and year from the dropdowns, or use the Prev / Next buttons to move between months.
The calendar grid renders instantly with correct weekdays, including 29-day February in leap years.
Today's date is highlighted automatically whenever you view the current month.
Click Print to open your browser's print dialog, where you can print the calendar or save it as a PDF.
